title: Draft: Expert: Move "same_name_next" to heap storage.
description:
A minimal alternative to !22541.  This MR fixes the ABI breakage by making 4.6.2+ compatible with 4.6.0 again, but not doing anything about compatibility with plugins built against 4.6.1 -- those will still crash when run with newer releases.

This could also go in to `master`; I reali[sz]ed late that I perhaps should have prepared this against `master` but for now I'll post it here for discussion as it is, against `release-4.6`.

----

Commit 5d49f6ca added the "same_name_next" field to the expert_field_info
structure, inadvertently breaking plugin ABI and leading to crashes inside
expert_register_field_array when the plugin build version and the application
version weren't identical.

Revert the ABI-breaking change, and extend the gpa_expertinfo array to provide
additional storage for the same_name_next field.

This will restore ABI compatibility between 4.6.0 and 4.6.2+, with 4.6.1 being
the incompatible outlier -- plugins built for 4.6.1 will fail on other builds
and vice-versa.

Fixes #20881.

Fixup 5d49f6ca.
